main.description: A binary attachment (image, PDF, etc.) in a Notesky-synced vault. The file bytes live in a blob; metadata is encrypted or plaintext to match the notes that embed it.

vault.description: rkey of the app.notesky.vault record this attachment belongs to

contentHash.description: sha256 hex of the stored blob bytes (ciphertext when encrypted) for transport integrity

blob.description: The file bytes; encrypted with the note-key scheme unless the attachment is public

wrappedKey.description: base64: per-attachment key wrapped by master key

contentNonce.description: base64: nonce used for the blob ciphertext
